research.notes: Agenda location (Orange, CA) conflicts with the headquarters found (Peachtree Corners, GA). The NPA master contract with Placentia-Yorba Linda USD lists Soliant Health, LLC at the Georgia address, so the Georgia entity is probably the same one, but it could not be confirmed that the OUSD vendor is not a separate California-based entity. No registry (SOS, SAM, GA) entries were verified; legal name and registry IDs left null.

profile.summary: Soliant Health is a staffing company that places school and healthcare professionals, such as special education teachers, speech-language pathologists, school psychologists, therapists and nurses, in schools and healthcare settings across the United States. It offers on-site, remote and teletherapy placements. The company says it has operated since 1992.
